description: AWS resource creation + S3 and SQS client wrappers. Create real AWS resources in ap-south-1 (S3 bucket csvforge-files-dev, SQS queue csvforge-jobs-dev, DLQ csvforge-jobs-dev-dlq), capture them in CloudFormation YAML, then implement backend/s3_client.py and backend/sqs_client.py with full moto-based unit tests. IMPORTANT: the current AWS credentials in ~/.aws/credentials are invalid (aws sts get-caller-identity returns InvalidClientTokenId). Before creating any AWS resource, run aws sts get-caller-identity and confirm a valid JSON response. If credentials are still invalid, document the error in findings and skip the actual resource creation CLI steps — but still write the CloudFormation YAML and the client code (they do not require live AWS to be tested, because moto mocks are used in unit tests).
steps: Step 1: Verify AWS credentials — run `aws sts get-caller-identity`. If valid, record Account ID, UserId, Arn in findings. If invalid, record the error, skip CLI resource creation, and continue with code-only steps.

Step 2 (CLI, only if credentials valid): Create S3 bucket `csvforge-files-dev` in ap-south-1 with all public access blocked. Run: `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket csvforge-files-dev --region ap-south-1 --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=ap-south-1` then `aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket csvforge-files-dev --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true`.

Step 3 (CLI, only if credentials valid): Add S3 CORS for browser direct upload. Put the JSON [{"AllowedHeaders":["*"],"AllowedMethods":["PUT"],"AllowedOrigins":["http://localhost:5173"],"ExposeHeaders":["ETag"]}] via `aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket csvforge-files-dev --cors-configuration <json>`.

Step 4 (CLI, only if credentials valid): Create DLQ first. Run: `aws sqs create-queue --queue-name csvforge-jobs-dev-dlq --region ap-south-1 --attributes MessageRetentionPeriod=345600`. Record the DLQ ARN from the response.
Step 5 (CLI, only if credentials valid): Create main SQS queue with redrive policy pointing at the DLQ. VisibilityTimeout=1800, MaxReceiveCount=5. Record the queue URL.

Step 6: Write `infrastructure/data.yaml` — CloudFormation template with AWS::S3::Bucket resource (BucketName: csvforge-files-dev, BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true, CorsConfiguration with PUT allowed from http://localhost:5173). Include educational comments explaining each property.

Step 7: Write `infrastructure/queues.yaml` — CloudFormation template with two AWS::SQS::Queue resources (DLQ: csvforge-jobs-dev-dlq with MessageRetentionPeriod 4 days; Main: csvforge-jobs-dev with VisibilityTimeout 1800, MessageRetentionPeriod 4 days, RedrivePolicy referencing the DLQ with maxReceiveCount 5). Include educational comments explaining VisibilityTimeout, DLQ, MaxReceiveCount per AD-17.

Step 8: Write `backend/s3_client.py` — implement get_s3_client(), generate_presigned_upload_url(bucket, key, expiry_seconds=900) with content-length-range [0, 52428800], generate_presigned_download_url(bucket, key, expiry_seconds=900), object_exists(bucket, key) -> bool, get_object_size(bucket, key) -> int, upload_file(bucket, key, file_path) -> None, download_file(bucket, key, dest_path) -> None. Full educational docstrings per documentation-style.md. The client reads AWS_ENDPOINT_URL from env for optional LocalStack override.

Step 9: Write `backend/sqs_client.py` — implement get_sqs_client(), send_job_message(queue_url, job_id, s3_key) -> str, parse_job_message(body: str) -> dict. Message body is JSON with job_id and s3_key only (never file content). Full educational docstrings.

Step 10: Write `tests/unit/test_s3_client.py` — moto[s3] based tests: generate_presigned_upload_url returns URL with bucket+key, object_exists True/False, get_object_size returns correct bytes, upload_file+download_file round-trip without data corruption. Use @mock_aws decorator (moto 5.x) and create the bucket before each test.

Step 11: Write `tests/unit/test_sqs_client.py` — moto[sqs] based tests: send_job_message returns a message ID string, parse_job_message returns correct job_id and s3_key, round-trip send+receive+parse preserves values. Use @mock_aws decorator and create the queue before each test.

Step 12: Update `.env` with S3_BUCKET_NAME=csvforge-files-dev, SQS_QUEUE_URL=https://sqs.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/{account_id}/csvforge-jobs-dev (use placeholder account ID if credentials were invalid), AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-south-1.
